headline: The shop says Friday closed. A directory still prints Friday open.
summary: This is a SAMPLE. Not a real shop. Cedar Gate Welding is a made-up fence, gate, and mobile-weld yard we wrote so you can see the sheet. The leftover is one hour card: the shop prints Monday through Thursday 7:30 to 5, Friday closed. A directory still prints Friday open. Phone is consistent. The site is real. Public photos still look like two lots ago. A neighbor who trusts the leftover Friday can drive to a yard that is locked.

signals.note: You show up for fences, gates, and a mobile weld. A neighbor looking for a gate can find you.
signals.next: Keep the category fence and mobile weld.

signals.note: The shop number is the same on the site and the listing. Call is how people book. That door works.
signals.next: Keep that number. Do not add a second one.

signals.note: The shop card is Monday through Thursday 7:30 to 5, Friday closed. A directory still prints Friday open. A leftover Friday is how a neighbor drives to a locked yard.
signals.next: Write one hour card, including Friday closed. Copy it to the listing the same morning.

signals.note: The work is gates. Public photos still show the old lot. A first-time neighbor cannot tell this year's yard from two lots ago.
signals.next: Put four current photos on the listing: this year's yard, a gate in progress, a finished fence, and the truck.

signals.note: The shop site loads and belongs to you. Phone and the week are there. The leftover Friday sits on a directory, not on the site.
signals.next: Keep the site. Take Friday open off the leftover card.

signals.note: Name and phone line up. The leftover is the week, not the pin.
signals.next: Keep the public pin. The hours card is the pass.
